corruptions.text: PLAN: First, identify which establishment is headquartered in Texas and closer to the southern part of the United States. Then, compare their locations relative to each other to determine which one is farther south.

descendants.hop_1: FINDING: Texas Instruments is headquartered in Dallas, while Texas Instruments Inc. is headquartered in Austin, both of which are located in Texas but closer to the southern part of the United States compared to each other.
